announcing_notice_sha256.description: Optional digest of the PublicNotice envelope that announced this snapshot.

control.description: Name of the control being observed.

status.description: Optional evaluation hint (operators may leave as unknown; observers may populate).

summary.description: One-line human summary; keep it short.

observed_at.description: When this snapshot was produced (best effort).

previous_snapshot_sha256.description: Optional digest of the prior snapshot payload in this series (anti-rollback / anti-rewrite).

snapshot_id.description: Stable identifier for this snapshot series (updates may chain via previous_snapshot_sha256).

snapshot_version.description: Schema version of this snapshot payload.

channels.description: Optional list of official channel IDs from artifacts/registries/official-channels.csv.

email_domain.description: Optional official email sending domain for public communications (e.g., elections.example).

primary_domain.description: Primary official web domain name (e.g., elections.example).
